&project;
Changelog
This release contains all of the changes up to and including those in Apache Tomcat 11.0.25 plus the additional changes listed below. (markt)
The minimum Java version has been updated to Java 21. (markt)
Lower the log level to debug when OpenSSL initialization fails in OpenSSLLifecycleListener to avoid stack traces when libssl.so is not present and to align the behavior of the isAvailable() check with the AprLifecycleListener and gracefully fail when natives are not present. (csutherl)
Prevent duplicate log messages when clustering JARs are not present on startup. (csutherl)
Add the Jakarta EE 12 XML schemas. (markt)
Add support for the new Servlet API method HttpServletResponse.sendEarlyHints(). (markt)
Remove JDBCAccessLogValve which provides limited functionality compared to what is expected from an AccessLog and was not implemented in a scalable way. (remm)
Added support for limiting the number of parameters in HTTP requests through the new ParameterLimitValve. The valve allows configurable URL-specific limits on the number of parameters. (dsoumis)
Remove the useAcceptRanges initialisation parameter for the default servlet. It is now effectively hard coded to true. (markt)
Change the default for the encodedSolidusHandling attribute of Context from decode to reject. (markt)
When searching the web application class loader for a resource or resources by name, align the behaviour with the JRE class loaders and always return null if the provided name starts with /. (markt)
Update StoreRegistry to dynamically load optional clustering classes rather than statically referencing them. This matches the pattern used in Catalina.addClusterRuleSet() and prevents NoClassDefFoundError when StoreConfigLifecycleListener is configured but clustering classes are not available. (csutherl)
Update the default value for the allowPostAsGet initialisation parameter of the Default servlet from true to false. This means a direct request (i.e. not a forward or an include) for a static resource using the POST method will be rejected by default. (markt)
Calls to HttpServletRequest.getContextPath() now return the canonical context path for the web application rather than the component of the request URI presented by the user agent that maps to the context path. (markt)
Change the default value of the archiveIndexStrategy attribute of the Resources element from simple to bloom to improve web application class loading performance. (markt)
Remove regular expression support for the configuration of internal and trusted proxies for the RemoteIpFilter and RemoteIpValve. (markt)
Remove the RemoteAddrFilter and RemoteAddrValve. (markt)
Change the default for the digestInRfc3112Order attribute of MessageDigestCredentialHandler from false to true. (markt)
Add constants to HttpServletResponse for the HTTP status codes defined in RFC 6585. (markt)
Enhance version.sh and version.bat to display APR, Tomcat Native, and OpenSSL version information (both APR and FFM implementations), along with version compatibility warnings and third-party library version information. (csutherl)
Reject BASIC authorization with no password, to comply with RFC 7617 strictly. (remm)
Reject BASIC authorization with empty user names as required by RFC 7613. (markt)
Add support for the HTTP QUERY method as defined in RFC 10008. Based on pull request 1026 by Mario Daniel Ruiz Saavedra. (markt)
Remove the Context attribute urlPatternsProvidedInDecodedForm and all supporting code. The attribute is now effectively hard-coded to true for all web applications which is a change from the default of false in Tomcat 11 and earlier. The default implementation of Context.addServletMapping(String,String,boolean) has been removed so classes that implement the Context interface must implement this method. (markt)
Improve the handling of AsyncContext.dispatch() when the Context attribute dispatchersUseEncodedPaths is set to false since the application has no control over the path used for the AsyncContext.dispatch(). Prior to this fix, paths containing literal '?' characters were truncated. (markt)
Ensure that capture groups from a RewriteCond always reflect the result of the current request. (markt)
When a PersistentManager needs to reduce the number of active sessions, swap out the least recently used eligible sessions first. Pull request 1045 provided by sainadh777. (markt)
Improve robustness of DIGEST authentication to system clock jumps. (markt)
Support multiple protocol header values (treat as a single merged header value) in the RemoteIpFilter and RemoteIpValve. (markt)
Fix potential concurrency issues when loading/saving sessions from/to a session store. Custom Store implementations that do not extend StoreBase must implement the new getSessionStoreLock() method of the Store interface to ensure concurrency protection. The default method implementation provided only provides the pre-fix functionality. (markt)
Ensure that PersistentManager implementations that extend PersistentManagerBase do not swap out sessions that are associated with a request that is currently being processed. This includes not swapping out a session unless the session was created when activity tracking was enabled. (markt)
Ensure namespace attributes are XML escaped in WebDAV responses. (markt)
Resolve null or missing rewrite substitutions as an empty string, to align with the mod_rewrite behavior. (remm)
Add a best efforts protection in the CrawlerSessionManagerValve against crawlers being associated with an authenticated session. (markt)
Clarify the meaning of various RewriteValve server variables and explicitly use the canonical context path for the CONTEXT_PATH server variable. (markt)
Fix storeconfig not saving the path when a context is saved in server.xml. (remm)
WAR URLConnection should propagate use of caching. (remm)
Ensure resources are evicted from the static resource cache in the correct order. (markt)
When Jakarta Authentication is configured for a web application, cache the ServerAuthConfig in the Authenticator valve. This ensures web application specific settings are cached on a per web application basis. (markt)
70203: Fix RegistrationListener notifications in Jakarta Authentication implementation. (markt)
Change the default value of the cookiesWithoutEquals attribute of the Rfc6265CookieProcessor from name to ignore. (markt)
Remove default password value (was changeit) for the certificateKeystorePassword attribute of a certificate. (remm)
Remove NIO2 connector. (remm)
Add specific certificate selection code for TLS 1.3 supporting post quantum cryptography. Certificates defined with type MLDSA will be selected depending on the TLS client hello. (remm)
Add groups attribute on SSLHostConfig allowing to restrict which groups can be enabled on the SSL engine. (remm)
Remove support for HTTP 0.9. (markt)
Fix parsing of client certificates that specify more than one OCSP responder for configurations that use OpenSSL-FFM. (markt)
xreflection generated code stack overflow issue. (remm)
Align xreflection better with IntrospectionUtils. (remm)
In HTTP/2 after half closed (remote), any unexpected frame should be a stream error. (remm)
Fix incorrect initial window size calculation when upgrading to HTTP/2. (remm)
Avoid HTTP/2 exceptions with invalid content-length values. (remm)
Only try and load the native library from the CATALINA_HOME system property when the property is set. (markt)
Fix max connections enforcement after an enpoint resume. (remm)
Implement stricter ALPN matching for Connectors using FFM. (markt)
Add length validation for ALPN protocol names. (markt)
Make FFM certificate verification more robust. (markt)
Align FFM OCSP URL parsing with Tomcat Native and treat a parsing failure as if no usable OCSP URLs were present. (markt)
Make the processing of OCSP responses more robust. (markt)
Stricter OCSP handling when soft-fail is disabled. (markt)
Cleaner handling of AJP response headers which overflow the maximum message size. (remm)
Small per performance optimisation. Don't waste cycles swallowing an AJP response body when the connection is going to be closed. (markt)
Fix OpenSSL support for CRLs when using OpenSSL trust with the server key held in a Java key store. (markt)
Reject HTTP/1.0 requests that send a transfer-encoding header. (markt)
Add support for the new Elvis (:?) and Null coalescing (??) operators in Jakarta Expression language. (markt)
Extend the existing += operator in Jakarta Expression Language to support merging Map and Set and concatenating Lists. (markt)
The defaults for compilerSourceVM and compilerTargetVM have been updated to 21 to align with Java 21 being the minimum Java version required for Tomcat 12. (markt)
Refactor the performance optimisation for jakarta.servlet.jsp.el.ImportELResolver to use the new marker class, jakarta.el.ELResolver.StandaloneIdentifierMarker. (markt)
Extend the support for relational operators to include TemporalAccessor, Clock and Date. (markt)
Add support for coercion to java.time.Instant and java.util.Date. (markt)
Add support for java.util.Optional to the empty operator. (markt)
Fix EL evaluation of some lambda expressions. (remm)
Validate that the DeltaManager attribute sendAllSessionsSize is a positive integer. Zero or negative values previously caused an infinite loop or a NegativeArraySizeException during session state transfer. Pull request 1042 provided by lihongyi87. (markt)
Improve robustness of cloud membership providers if an error occurs fetching members. (remm)
Update Tomcat's WebSocket support to version 2.3 of the Jakarta WebSocket API. (markt)
Implement the new HandshakeRequest method, getUserX509CertificateChain() that provides the client certificate chain, if present, during the WebSocket handshake. (markt)
Implement the clarification in WebSocket 2.3 that the method ClientEndpointConfig.Configurator.afterResponse() must be called after every WebSocket handshake regardless of whether the handshake is successful or not. (markt)
Implement the new HandshakeRequest methods that expose the client's preferred local and the local and remote host name, address and port information. (markt)
69920: When attempting to write a message via a WebSocket session that has been closed, throw an IOException rather than an IllegalStateExcpetion for consistency with Writer and OutputStream. (markt)
Fix an exception when an automatic Pong response races with the closing of the WebSocket session. Pull request 1041 provided by moritzfl. (markt)
Harden the WebSocket client and use a SecureRandom when generating the Sec-WebSocket-Key header. (markt)
Improve robustness of client handshakes. (remm)
Ensure that WebSocket write timeouts apply to the complete message and are not lost if two writes have the same timeout. (markt)
Reduce CPU usage while sending WebSocket close message. (markt)
Fix overly broad check that prevented request URIs containing literal { and } characters from being mapped to WebSocket end points. (markt)
Manager: Drop session handling dedicated to extracting the locale from Tapestry attributes, used for locale session sorting. (remm)
Manager: Fix a potential concurrency issue when ordering sessions prior to displaying a list of session. (markt)
Wrap the RewriteRule regular expression syntax reference on narrow displays. Pull request 1044 by sainadh777. (markt)
DataSourceProxy.getPooledConnection(String,String) now delegates to getConnection(String,String) rather than getConnection(). (markt)
Log a warning if an attempt is made to obtain a connection with credentials when alternateUsernameAllowed is set to false. (markt)
Update Maven Resolver Ant Tasks to 1.6.1. (rjung)
Add test profile system for selective test execution. Profiles can be specified via -Dtest.profile=<name> to run specific test subsets without using patterns directly. Profile patterns are defined in test-profiles.properties. (csutherl)
Update Derby to 10.17.1.0. (markt)
Add warning when OpenSSL binary is not found. (csutherl)
Add check for Tomcat Native library, and log warning when it's not found to make it easier to see when it's not used by the suite. (csutherl)
Update Checkstyle to 14.1.0. (markt)
Update Easymock to 5.7.0. (markt)
Update bnd to 7.4.0. (markt)
